visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A title screen opens with a yellow and blue graphic frame. A female host's head is visible in a small circular inset at the top. Large Traditional Chinese characters pose a question about CES and robotic opportunities. The background is a static colorful layout. (2) The woman appears centered in a studio with warm indoor lighting. She wears a dark green knitted sweater and eyeglasses. She speaks actively with facial expressions and hand gestures. Behind her are shelves with books and a purple circular light fixture. (3) A digital document shows Hypershell Co., Ltd. winning the 2025 Best of Innovation in Robotics at CES. The text is crisp and clear on a white background with an 'Innovation Awards' logo. The host's face is not visible. (4) Outdoor footage shows a person from the waist down wearing a black and gray mechanical exoskeleton attached to their legs. They are walking and then running up a rocky, light-brown hillside. Text '2 ms Response Time' appears in large white letters. (5) The scene returns to the female host in the same studio environment. She continues to gesture with her hands, palms up and moving outward, as she explains the broader implications of the technology. The lighting remains bright and professional.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: CES展有什麼股點？機器人商機竟然就在這裡！. [Logo]: Emmy 追劇時間. [Subtitle]: 這次CES機器人類別的這個創新大獎. (2) [Subtitle]: 他們就頒給了一家叫做Hypershell的公司. (3) [Subtitle]: 他們的產品是一種可以裝在腿上的一個叫做「外骨骼裝甲」的產品. (4) [Subtitle]: 你的腿上只要穿了他的這個外骨骼支架呢. [Variety]: 2 ms Response Time. (5) [Subtitle]: 他這個支架就會支撐你腿部的力量. (6) [Subtitle]: 那你可以跑得超快. (7) [Subtitle]: 如果繼續的進步下去, 原本坐輪椅的人真的就可以站起來走路. (8) [Subtitle]: 甚至是你可以把它用在戰場上面. (9) [Subtitle]: 到最後呢會變得很像漫威電影裡面的鋼鐵人裝甲. (10) [Subtitle]: 所以就真的是未來不可限量. (11) [Slogan]: 掌握獨家商業話題 請加入Emmy頻道會員 鎖定最精彩的追劇 按超級感謝 贊助我們.
